status: Native Finance chart-of-accounts management verified on desktop and mobile; finance/feature-chart-of-accounts closes

behavior.read: charts/{id}/accounts returns the selected chart, its accounts ordered by code and the Company periods; the chart page uses this native read
behavior.chart: create chart validates name/ISO currency/basis, unique Company name, inserts the active chart and writes finance.chart.create receipt/audit/outbox
behavior.account: create account validates chart, code/name/category/control kind, unique code, defaults currency to the chart base and writes finance.account.create
behavior.import: import up to 500 validated rows under one finance.account.import receipt, rejecting duplicate codes inside the import or against the chart
behavior.status: expectedVersion guard, unchanged-status conflict, inactive blocks draft journals and open invoices, writes finance.account.active/inactive
behavior.period: create period validates the calendar range and unique Company date range, writes an open period with finance.period.create
behavior.scope: Company scope only; current Account/Holding authority, rendered-context CAS, finance.read/finance.write, module.finance.read and the finance.accounting or finance.sales-posting purchase
behavior.atomicity: serializable transaction with finance_charts/accounts/periods share-row-exclusive locks and row locks for status

cases: chart/account/period read for the selected chart
chart create with receipt/audit/outbox, replay and duplicate-name conflict
account create with default currency, control account, duplicate-code conflict
status active -> inactive -> unchanged conflict -> stale conflict -> active with versions 2 and 3
inactive blocked by a draft journal and by an open invoice
period create, duplicate date range and invalid range
HTTP chart/account/period create and chart accounts read with real cookie/CAS/key
